'''R1-H5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] available for purchase in the galaxy at some point before and during the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
R1-H5 Astromech Droid is a pet companion, added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with Update 4.1 and available from the Anarchist Cartel Pack.
